name: Out of the Frame: your clip
description: You, painted in oils into a gold frame on a museum wall. The painting comes alive, the paint lifts off, and the real you leans out of the frame toward the camera: your own clip, not a generated one.

clip.label: A 6-10 s selfie clip: phone propped about 2 m away, sit still a second, then lean in toward it
